channel.title: My on Solarhub Help Center
channel.description: Recent content in My on Solarhub Help Center

item.title: Switch Perspective
item.description: Select My in the menu bar at the bottom of the APP, and you can switch the access mode of the App in Switch perspective There are two access perspectives, professional consultant and end user Professional consultant: Use the APP as an equipment manufacturer or dealer, focusing on all plants and equipment under the platform End user: Use the APP as a plant owner, focusing on my plant and equipment

item.title: Change Password
item.description: To change the password, you need to send a verification code to the account-bound email address After filling in the correct verification code, you can reset your password

item.title: Account Cancellation
item.description: When an account is deactivated or no longer used, you can delete the account information by canceling the account. At this time, all data generated by the account on the platform will be cleared

item.title: Network Configuration
item.description: Go to “My” at the bottom of the APP and click Network Configuration to enter the network configuration interface and prepare for network configuration To configure the network, you need to turn on Bluetooth, connect to 2.4GhzWIFi, and authorize Bluetooth WiFi and other permissions to the APP, otherwise the network configuration may fail. Add a device in the upper right corner, add a device by scanning the code or manually entering the serial number If the device enters the network configuration state, it will appear to be checked.

item.title: OTA Assistant
item.description: Click OTA Assistant in the “My” interface at the bottom of the APP The firmware redeemed with the redemption code will be displayed in the list Click Redeem in the upper right corner to redeem the firmware with the redemption code. For redemption code generation, refer to the Web Click Firmware Upgrade to enter the upgrade interface Select the device to be upgraded, and the list will display the online devices under the plant in the current plant overview for upgrade
